programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 吳宣倫博士-教會的奧秘
programme.desc: 在舊約中沒有「教會」二字,但歌羅西書1 章24至27節就提到基督的身體是教會,怎樣才是教會?怎樣的教會才是合神心意?讓吳宣倫博士從《聖經》中揭開這歷世歷代所隱藏的奧秘。

programme.title: 創世電視復興祭壇
programme.desc: 與影音使團創世電視成為一家人,一起在「創世電視復興祭壇」,以禱告和敬拜守望香港。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-婚姻的藍圖
programme.desc: 何偉強牧師從婚姻中遇到的不同課題,包括理財、溝通、姻親關係、性愛……助你從《聖經》中瞭解處理方法,你經營一段美好的婚姻。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 福音電影: 天地孩兒
programme.desc: 新生兒科權威余宇熙教授,為墨爾本Monash Medical Centre新生兒科部的主管二十多年。三十年來在新生兒科不斷研究中,余教授多次突破拯救早產嬰兒的限制,將搶救期由廿八週前至廿三週,成就顯赫,為華人在西方醫學界中帶來震撼。余教授積極聯繫澳洲維多利亞省內四間新生兒科深切治療部,組織一個完善拯救早產嬰兒的交通系統(Newborn Emergency Transport Service,簡稱 NETS)。在短短三年間,一共協助搶救了5437名初生及早產嬰兒。

programme.desc: 新生兒科權威余宇熙教授,為墨爾本Monash Medical Centre新生兒科部的主管二十多年。三十年來在新生兒科不斷研究中,余教授多次突破拯救早產嬰兒的限制,將搶救期由廿八週前至廿三週,成就顯赫,為華人在西方醫學界中帶來震撼。余教授積極聯繫澳洲維多利亞省內四間新生兒科深切治療部,組織一個完善拯救早產嬰兒的交通系統(Newborn Emergency Transport Service,簡稱 NETS)。在短短三年間,一共協助搶救了5437名初生及早產嬰兒。

programme.title: 讚美之泉
programme.desc: 一首既悅耳又有意思的詩歌,可以洗滌心靈,感化人心,創世電視帶你走進福音歌曲新領域。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-唔做黑幫做牧師
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
屁屁偵探電影：梳乎厘島的秘密粵日
programme.desc: 怪盜U預告要偷走梳乎里島上的風之路標，屁屁偵探帶同布朗隨汪汪警察局的警官到島上協助保安工作。露露擅長飛行，但對風之守護者的職責不以為然，她一心渴望離開梳乎里島，與怪盜U一拍即合。

programme.title: 劇場版 角落小夥伴 藍色月夜的魔法之子粵日
programme.desc: 秋季的某一天，角落小夥伴們一起外出露營。愉快的時光轉眼間就過去了，然後在那個夜晚，一如往常的城鎮被施展了不可思議的魔法…？

programme.title: 錦心似玉#13粵普
programme.desc: 經過賑災一事，徐令宜對十一娘的印象變好，隨著相處的機會增多，兩人的距離也日漸拉近。十一娘到仙綾閣教授繡技，卻重遇林世顯。另邊廂，徐令宜將一個不知名的小孩帶回徐府，叫十一娘照顧他，此事很快就傳遍徐府。

programme.title: 芬蘭潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 芬蘭第一站，梁芷珮抵達北部拉普蘭區，玩轉聖誕老人村及周邊地帶！想暖笠笠感受聖誕氣氛？不妨到室內主題樂園，欣賞特色表演、參觀冰雕展覽。樹屋酒店內設桑拿房，讓住客歎雪景等極光。每逢聖誕節前夕，聖誕老人村皆會舉行開幕禮，芷珮有幸參與盛會，並探望聖誕老人。親親雪橇狗之後，她還與馴鹿來一趟森林漫步。在漆黑環境下，躺在冰水上飄浮，好奇妙！要玩盡聖誕老人村，必住附近酒店，紅屋經濟實惠；玻璃屋則可「瞓住」賞極光。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 老友記容易有夜尿問題，老人科醫生指這情況不僅影響睡眠質素，甚至可引致抑鬱、焦慮，詳情如何？出現甚麼狀況應盡快求醫？醫生除了詳析夜尿的診治資訊，還會就着長者記性差，提供改善建議。聽到「朱古力品鑑師」這職銜，不少人或想到可經常吃朱古力，究竟實際的工作日常是怎樣？現職朱古力品鑑師細談如何分辨優質朱古力，以及品鑑朱古力的步驟，還分享對港產膶腸朱古力印象深刻。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨師傅呈獻「法式煎鵝肝牛柳」。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 謝東閔、譚嘉儀認為體力消耗法、呼吸睡眠法及精神降低法，哪個方法較易入眠？精神科醫生還會講解何謂「褪黑激素」。物理治療師糾正東閔的奇怪睡姿，又分析多種睡姿的優劣，左右側睡原來各有好處。「瞓好啲」有辦法，瑜伽達人陳雅思示範三款修復瑜伽，有助放鬆神經與思維。逆齡偵探體驗台北午睡Cafe，多功能按摩椅令你安然入夢，午睡神器、發熱眼罩能幫助睡眠？中醫師並推介三花安神茶。另有營養師拆解吸收膠原蛋白的謬誤。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#23粵PG
programme.desc: 柏義成為集團代主席後，躊躇滿志。駿昇擔心林磊狀況，坦言不能不理他。冠一則傳短訊給柏義，勸他立即收手。余老闆約柏義談合作事宜，要求七三分帳，柏義爽快答應，但暗中設局要余老闆讓出其賭場。柏義警告眾同門不要阻撓他成為新賭王，還提出與天龍上契，合作雄霸亞洲。世峰、丁權到醫院救走林磊，柏義猜到司徒省的目標是冒簽的授權書，出手阻止，並狠下心腸……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 藤木為了和笹山玩家家酒，不惜放朋友鴿子，結果東窗事發，藤木想辦法希望兩全其美。聖誕節將至，為確保收到聖誕禮物，大家都刻意學乖，希望爭取聖誕老人的好印象，其後又發現助人為樂確是真。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子把習字簿忘了在學校，回去拿的時候，卻發現自己的座位上有一份神秘聖誕禮物。丸尾花了三天時間編寫過去一年的總結表，卻被母親誤以為廢紙丟掉，兩母子之間氣氛尷尬，卻碰上丸尾生日將至。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 聖誕節放假在家，各位也可以收看「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，跟隨環節一起做運動鍛練身體。兒童體適能教練這回指導大家進行全身訓練，動作包括弓箭步、平板支撐、後踢腿、開合跳等。完成某動作之後，教練問眾人感受如何，彤彤姐姐笑言「無難度」！另外，本集還會播放 AI生成動畫《紅鼻子的馴鹿》下半部份。故事中，聖誕老人受到大風雪阻礙，最終能否趕及派送禮物給小朋友？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 在社交網絡中，一幅陽葵與美月的可愛插畫成為了話題。同學們都圍繞著畫師葛飾結心齋熱烈討論。與此同時，陽葵與同學花園結心被選為新一期班報負責人，陽葵很想與結心成為朋友，然而結心非常害羞，難以親近……

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2710粵
programme.desc: 雖然Bonnie已成為片場話事人，但未能如潮偉或尚善般統率各人，眾人工作散漫。樹根臨時提出請假，並擅自大幅刪改劇本，Bonnie終於忍無可忍，竟當眾斥責樹根，並憤然離去。她事後感到惴惴不安，幸而想到一個解決方法，成功安撫樹根。另一方面，樹根經此事後，竟經常設法「博取」Bonnie責罵，原來另有盤算，此法初時成效顯著，其後卻發現如意算盤打不響。眾人對樹根態度大變，他惟有設法補救，詎料……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#8粵PG
programme.desc: 出警時，棠哥發現紅姐茫然地走在大街上且沒帶手機，想要將紅姐強行帶回家，而發病的紅姐已經認不出棠哥，此事被遊行隊伍中的好事者抓住時機故意刁難。就在棠哥百口莫辯之際，三號車其他隊友趕到。

programme.title: 宿敵契約#4粵普
programme.desc: 隨歌欲阻止兩國聯姻，不料戲陽心甘情願嫁給靜石，他雖心裡痛苦無奈，最終選擇成全戲陽，當晚一笑陪隨歌暢飲解愁，二人感情悄悄萌芽…靜石將抵達玉京城，忠心的神射手雲青知道隨歌不同意聯姻，自作主張要去暗殺靜石。

programme.title: MSIG iTravel Go 旅遊保險呈獻：塔斯曼尼亞潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 登上海拔近二千米的山峰，可俯瞰荷伯特全城面貌。山腳下兩百年歷史啤酒廠裡，芷珮試飲不同口味。離開荷伯特，來到西南面小鎮稍作停留。芷珮於咖啡店嚐一口蛋糕，再行逛餐具二手店。繼續前往體驗河畔柴火飄浮式桑拿，悠閒寫意。抵達朗瑟士敦附近的森林保護區，芷珮玩飛索從高空觀賞自然風光。入住附設野外熱水浴池的酒店，芷珮浸浴其間有袋鼠路過，酒店還設有可眺望塔斯曼海的桑拿。她還參與夜觀企鵝行程，安靜地跟企鵝近距離接觸。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵

programme.title: 長命不老粵

programme.title: 芬蘭潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 芬蘭第一站，梁芷珮抵達北部拉普蘭區，玩轉聖誕老人村及周邊地帶！想暖笠笠感受聖誕氣氛？不妨到室內主題樂園，欣賞特色表演、參觀冰雕展覽。樹屋酒店內設桑拿房，讓住客歎雪景等極光。每逢聖誕節前夕，聖誕老人村皆會舉行開幕禮，芷珮有幸參與盛會，並探望聖誕老人。親親雪橇狗之後，她還與馴鹿來一趟森林漫步。在漆黑環境下，躺在冰水上飄浮，好奇妙！要玩盡聖誕老人村，必住附近酒店，紅屋經濟實惠；玻璃屋則可「瞓住」賞極光。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#13粵普
programme.desc: 經過賑災一事，徐令宜對十一娘的印象變好，隨著相處的機會增多，兩人的距離也日漸拉近。十一娘到仙綾閣教授繡技，卻重遇林世顯。另邊廂，徐令宜將一個不知名的小孩帶回徐府，叫十一娘照顧他，此事很快就傳遍徐府。

programme.title: 乜都搞掂晒粵
programme.desc: 要快速處理粟米、薯仔、青瓜、蝦等沙律食材，陳敏之有小貼士「醒醒」大家！為何切青瓜時要貼一支牙籤在刀邊？想將食物真空保存，一大缸水便足夠？嚴選五大網球趣怪用途，網球隨時變身零錢包、掛架及按摩器！

programme.title: 乜都搞掂晒粵
programme.desc: 主婦學會極速執屋大法，變出空餘時間！摺被、燙衣有甚麼加速建議？江美儀帶來黑絲襪，可清潔甚麼？道破黑色、紅色廁所泵之別。利用「切絲」膠手套發揮智慧，解決生活問題。切洋蔥前做甚麼工夫可避免「流淚」？

programme.title: 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
屁屁偵探電影：天才惡人屁屁亞蒂 + 夢幻的巨無霸番薯批慶典粵日
programme.desc: 本故事由兩部份組成。第一部份：幸運貓老闆閃到腰後不小心訂了十倍的貨量，為了清貨大家製作了一個巨型番薯批。第二部份:屁屁亞蒂想偷走博物館的寶物帕茲，屁屁偵探雖然一度被打敗，但最後在大家幫助下成功破案。

programme.title: 雙祥見粵PG
programme.desc: 今集破天荒邀來兩位重量級嘉賓：張衛健及麥長青，經典西遊記三師兄弟廿多年後難得重逢，當年新秀同屆對手阮兆祥及張衛健再遇！四個大男人大爆聖誕開P瘋狂經歷，更大玩真心話大冒險，兄弟情誼大受挑戰

programme.title: 錦心似玉#14粵普 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 徐令宜帶回來的鳳卿原來是徐令寬的私生子，徐令宜為此與徐令寬爭吵，十一娘勸令宜與令寬好好談談，二人終解開心結，令寬決定去向岳父請罪。喬蓮房故意告訴丹陽鳳卿乃令寬私生子一事，丹陽氣得跑去找十一娘理論。

programme.title: 芬蘭潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 芬蘭有農場飼養了近百頭哈士奇犬，芷珮擔任狗義工，帶狗狗到森林散步。騎着電動單車探索雪白森林，好寫意！芬蘭首間科學館由舊工廠改建，芷珮登上百年水塔，還會試玩大浪下的救生艇、轉圈滾桶等趣味裝置。玩樂過後，她下榻圓形玻璃小屋，更幸運地等到極光！芷珮及後深入當地漁村，隨漁民學網魚，一嘗即烤即食吃法，但燒魚驚變燒手套？農場版密室逃脫遊戲，解謎的同時，還可親親小動物。置身芬蘭與瑞典的交界處，一步「穿梭」兩國！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 都市傳說指長時間吹風扇會引致面癱？神經外科醫生列舉此症成因與高危因素。除了傳統診斷方法，現時還會採用AI輔助診斷以得出更精準結果？至於治療方案，甚麼情況下需要施手術？不少人會為保障家人而立平安紙(遺囑)，但怎樣的一張平安紙才可做到具有法律效力？律師拆解將箇中細節。嘉賓還提醒，人生不同年齡階段也可能有需要更新平安紙內容。「睇餸食飯」，Annie顧及菜與肉的平衡，炮製一道「燒焗豬肋排配法式燜雜菜」。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 佛山三水長壽鄉有礦沙浴，有何護膚益處？皮膚科醫生講解礦沙浴可令毛孔及血管擴張，有助吸收礦物質及促進血液循環；中醫師亦指其溫熱效果，有助氣血流通舒緩痛症。皮膚科醫生解釋橙皮紋的成因，以及教授淡化橙皮紋運動。長期使用單邊嘴嚼或頸部傾側，容易造成一邊臉肌肉過大，物理治療師示範改善肩頸痠痛運動，減低大細臉機會。營養師分析韓國泡菜的凍齡功效，綠茶加入甚麼更能發揮抗氧化作用？了解黑眼圈的成因，減淡眼圈有妙法！

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#24粵PG
programme.desc: 柏義刪除所有相關閉路電視畫面，向司警揚言不認識司徒省，令世峰等人無可奈何。柏義出席司徒省的葬禮，冠一揚言彼此不再是兄弟，並會為司徒省報仇。冠一、駿昇均獲家人支持，到澳門為司徒省復仇。駿昇未能成功拉攏其他董事拉柏義下台。柏義約駿昇與冠一去蔣廬，見證他與天龍上契，雙方勢成水火。曦昕擔心駿昇，與家聰到澳門找Derek合作，反被柏義警告。曦昕看到美詩對義父關懷備至，並訴說家事，若有所思……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子、小玉和俊子約好一起做櫻餅，然後帶去邊賞櫻花邊吃，其間小丸子遇到小杉，並提出與他交換食物。佐佐木爺爺生日，小丸子想到畫畫送給他作生日禮物，並拜託其孫子晴彥寫上祝賀語句。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 媽媽收起被爐，小丸子跟嫲嫲一起去散步��買鶯餅，途中看見濱治和山田在吸收太陽精華，然後也加入。小丸子看過市民藝術展後，興起用自己的收藏品開展覽的念頭，冬田得知後請求同時展出她的貼紙。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 聖誕樹是聖誕節的標誌之一，「Artspiration」插圖師指引小朋友從聖誕樹最頂的星星開始，繪畫出幾層高的聖誕樹。樹下當然要添加各式各樣的禮物，怎樣才可畫得更立體？雛型出現後，繼續用畫筆來「佈置」眼前的聖誕樹吧！除了聖誕節，香港也會慶祝不同節日，小朋友投稿「開心SHARE」，寄來一些關於復活節、中秋節、端午節的相片。主持亦請來嘉賓蔡華英(Emily姐姐)，暢談慶節活動的樂趣，以及應節食品的喜好。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 偶像公主空間最近有傳鬧鬼，千依也在直播中追查，令怕鬼的美月看得當場昏倒。為了抓住幽靈，陽葵決定前往偶像公主空間，還找上同場的千依組成偵探團，一起調查鬧鬼的真相。到底幽靈的真正身分是誰？

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 跑馬地一個三房單位，享有全馬場景，設計師利用家具布局突顯景觀，同時保證有充足收納空間，效果如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 天水圍某公屋住戶被指在家門外、走廊張貼古怪字條、溪錢，更曾於大廈內燒衣，怪異行為令街坊感不安。攝製隊前往視察，向該住戶了解情況。單位天花剝落、渠管淤塞，租客夫婦難以忍受，想於死約期內搬走。地產經紀朋友聲稱只需指出單位有問題，就可放下鎖匙、自行搬出，並向業主索償。租客照辦後卻遭業主控告，申索不成反要賠錢？律師提供處理退租問題的注意事項。《萬千星輝頒獎典禮》各獎項競爭激烈，王敏奕、陳瀅、劉洋落力拉票。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2711粵
programme.desc: 若水、力蓮各自籌備慶祝結婚四週年的紀念活動，力蓮的計劃極盡奢華，卻反而被若水比下去，遂設法「搞破壞」。龔燁被迫只能低調慶祝，卻於陰差陽錯下適得其反。傳媒大事報道龔燁的愛妻舉動，並打算追訪兩人的結婚週年慶祝活動。然而，龔燁突然接到消息，急需出埠處理某些事情，可能無法趕回來和若水慶祝。另一邊廂，力蓮在結婚紀念日當天準備與瑞輝慶祝，卻突生變故，更陷入淪為眾人笑柄的危機……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#9粵PG
programme.desc: 安娜叮囑阿肯要妥善處理刀疤馮，並向路易士報告，汪東凱已經成為眾矢之的。陳耀揚帶人抓捕刀疤馮，被其逃脫，阿肯告訴刀疤馮安心跑路，已經安排刀疤馮的弟弟阿龍接手了他的工作，還給了阿龍一個新場地。

programme.title: 宿敵契約#5粵普PG
programme.desc: 一笑在城樓看見靜石，立時思緒紊亂，隨歌讓她平靜下來。隨歌不同意一笑去見靜石，即使雪影暗中安排，亦從中作梗。靜石終與一笑見面，並表示會帶她回錦繡。一笑從寧非口中得知自己當日墮崖與平陵一戰計劃有變有關。

programme.title: MSIG iTravel Go 旅遊保險呈獻：塔斯曼尼亞潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 芷珮來到搖籃山(Cradle Mountain)的國家公園，選擇以皮划艇遊湖遙看景色。到訪野生動物中心，僅數月大的塔斯曼尼亞惡魔，模樣可愛。芷珮私心推介的民宿，躺在床上也可欣賞美景。跟隨當地推薦的工場美食路徑，芷珮於紅桑子農場，以紅桑子班戟開展美好一天。走訪芝士工房，芥末味芝士令她豎起拇指大讚。三文魚養殖場的三文魚配人蔘香料，滋味難忘。尾站在蜂蜜工場「瘋狂」試吃不同特色口味蜜糖，旅程既驚喜又滿足。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
名媛望族#10粵PG
programme.desc: 小由請啟燊教她寫父親名字，Ali發現案例中被判死刑者的姓氏與小由相同。爾嫣問子君有多愛卓萬。爾嫣送茶給卓萬，告訴卓萬子君很愛他，卓萬指爾嫣不愛他。子君欲測試卓萬。子君果然在上海等到卓萬出現，向她求婚。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 天水圍某公屋住戶被指在家門外、走廊張貼古怪字條、溪錢，更曾於大廈內燒衣，怪異行為令街坊感不安。攝製隊前往視察，向該住戶了解情況。單位天花剝落、渠管淤塞，租客夫婦難以忍受，想於死約期內搬走。地產經紀朋友聲稱只需指出單位有問題，就可放下鎖匙、自行搬出，並向業主索償。租客照辦後卻遭業主控告，申索不成反要賠錢？律師提供處理退租問題的注意事項。《萬千星輝頒獎典禮》各獎項競爭激烈，王敏奕、陳瀅、劉洋落力拉票。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 都市傳說指長時間吹風扇會引致面癱？神經外科醫生列舉此症成因與高危因素。除了傳統診斷方法，現時還會採用AI輔助診斷以得出更精準結果？至於治療方案，甚麼情況下需要施手術？不少人會為保障家人而立平安紙(遺囑)，但怎樣的一張平安紙才可做到具有法律效力？律師拆解將箇中細節。嘉賓還提醒，人生不同年齡階段也可能有需要更新平安紙內容。「睇餸食飯」，Annie顧及菜與肉的平衡，炮製一道「燒焗豬肋排配法式燜雜菜」。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 佛山三水長壽鄉有礦沙浴，有何護膚益處？皮膚科醫生講解礦沙浴可令毛孔及血管擴張，有助吸收礦物質及促進血液循環；中醫師亦指其溫熱效果，有助氣血流通舒緩痛症。皮膚科醫生解釋橙皮紋的成因，以及教授淡化橙皮紋運動。長期使用單邊嘴嚼或頸部傾側，容易造成一邊臉肌肉過大，物理治療師示範改善肩頸痠痛運動，減低大細臉機會。營養師分析韓國泡菜的凍齡功效，綠茶加入甚麼更能發揮抗氧化作用？了解黑眼圈的成因，減淡眼圈有妙法！

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#24粵PG
programme.desc: 柏義刪除所有相關閉路電視畫面，向司警揚言不認識司徒省，令世峰等人無可奈何。柏義出席司徒省的葬禮，冠一揚言彼此不再是兄弟，並會為司徒省報仇。冠一、駿昇均獲家人支持，到澳門為司徒省復仇。駿昇未能成功拉攏其他董事拉柏義下台。柏義約駿昇與冠一去蔣廬，見證他與天龍上契，雙方勢成水火。曦昕擔心駿昇，與家聰到澳門找Derek合作，反被柏義警告。曦昕看到美詩對義父關懷備至，並訴說家事，若有所思……

programme.title: 芬蘭潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 芬蘭有農場飼養了近百頭哈士奇犬，芷珮擔任狗義工，帶狗狗到森林散步。騎着電動單車探索雪白森林，好寫意！芬蘭首間科學館由舊工廠改建，芷珮登上百年水塔，還會試玩大浪下的救生艇、轉圈滾桶等趣味裝置。玩樂過後，她下榻圓形玻璃小屋，更幸運地等到極光！芷珮及後深入當地漁村，隨漁民學網魚，一嘗即烤即食吃法，但燒魚驚變燒手套？農場版密室逃脫遊戲，解謎的同時，還可親親小動物。置身芬蘭與瑞典的交界處，一步「穿梭」兩國！

programme.title: 錦心似玉#14粵普
programme.desc: 徐令宜帶回來的鳳卿原來是徐令寬的私生子，徐令宜為此與徐令寬爭吵，十一娘勸令宜與令寬好好談談，二人終解開心結，令寬決定去向岳父請罪。喬蓮房故意告訴丹陽鳳卿乃令寬私生子一事，丹陽氣得跑去找十一娘理論。

programme.title: 區區開伙粵
programme.desc: 主持與梁嘉琪到訪九龍城，找尋足以令人「嘩」一聲的美食。甚麼美食能令喬寶寶破了戒也不知？打開九龍城區「覓食懶人包」。自製全牛、全豬、全海鮮宴，發掘新鮮感。孫慧雪作出環球美食推介，吃盡雪糕、點心、爐端燒。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 粉紅之城齋浦爾以印度人最喜愛的藍色陶瓷聞名 獨一無二的手工藝品, 是送禮的上品 隨著平價的工廠製陶器引入而一度銷聲匿跡的藍陶, 全靠印度的代表藝術家克里帕爾令它復活, 這份珍貴的文化遺產材得以流傳至今

programme.title: 排檔尋情味粵英
programme.desc: 走進新加坡不同世代小販的生活，感受他們之間的關愛、爭吵以及他們對彼此堅定不移的支持。

programme.title: 西葡潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 置身里斯本山城，不想迷路，芷珮建議先從市中心廣場出發，乘搭電車亦不錯。想一展美術天分？可到特定規劃的公眾地方合法塗鴉，看看芷珮和兩子創意無限的傑作！潮人芷珮到活化工廠區，大吃多款雞菜式；閒逛由紡織廠改建的復古書店，變身文青。即興短遊西班牙名城西維爾，在地標西班牙廣場打卡後，芷珮登上小艇，圍繞廣場浪漫「遊船河」；再走上木製藝術建築最高點，Chill爆欣賞夕陽。芷珮品嚐葡式國民美食豬排包，立食也滋味！

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 灣仔區經過多年發展，新舊文化共冶一爐，衛志豪、譚嘉儀、謝東閔一次過遊遍區內不同年代特色景點。於鬧市欣賞維港日落景緻，感覺浪漫寫意。三人走進香港故事館，從懷舊展品中尋找港人的拼搏痕跡。深入80年歷史露天市集，貼地感受灣仔街坊人情味。日式海鮮市場每日引進新鮮食材，刺身愛好者必然食指大動。經典大牌檔面臨絕跡，三人從香滑奶茶中細味過去60載輝煌點滴。嘉儀拿起結他在姻緣石前大唱情歌，莫非她在呼喚愛情來臨？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 名人馬斯克除了是世界首富，還兼具多重身分。谷主們都對其人生故事充滿好奇，並設題討論。凱婷概述馬斯克的成長經歷與發跡過程，原來他曾被幼稚園校長認為智力發展遲緩！對於AI會否取代人類工作，凱文、泳嘉各有不同看法。馬斯克於推動AI發展影響深遠，但他曾在演講中直言AI是人類最大的生存威脅？三位谷主還會談論對馬斯克的深刻印象，泳嘉、凱文分別引述其金句，勉勵大家勇於面對挫折，凱婷則談到馬斯克的非一般營商理念。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 海藻掌門人粵英
programme.desc: 海藻越來越受歡迎，其多樣性不斷給美食家帶來驚喜。無論它們是因為營養特性、碘化風味還是美觀而受到追捧，它們都注定會征服世界。我們將踏上一段旅程，追尋這些特殊海藻的足跡。

programme.title: 全城一叮粵
programme.desc: 謝采芝藉一叮舞台追尋歌手夢，惟被指揀錯歌，她再唱一曲，為「復活」最後一拼！黃紫恩、劉展霆一拍即合，以性感火辣舞蹈引來陣陣尖叫，有人竟將焦點放在黑絲上……方紹聰、關嘉敏大膽挑戰棟篤笑，卻陷入被叮絕境，遂加碼展示Beatbox、Rap唱才藝，能否「重生」？在媽媽現場打氣下，陳懿德變身「女神」獻聲，自信心大增。入行逾廿載的劉家聰，戰勝重病歸來，冀以手影故事重獲觀眾掌聲；其女兒驚喜上台給予鼓勵，場面催淚！

programme.title: 你想減壓粵
programme.desc: 股評人胡孟青經常要不分晝夜地留意各地波動的股市，情緒亦易有起伏，隨時影響睡眠質素。青姐笑言豐滿身型源於喜歡吃喝，其減壓妙法是用餐或消閒時遠離「行家」，適當時機還要學懂放下！聆聽ASMR錄音、輕鬆音樂，均可幫助入睡，但原來經過慎選，「噪音」亦可助眠？註冊音樂治療師細說白噪音與粉紅噪音的分類。除聽覺外，透過嗅覺感受香薰的味道，也可舒緩緊張。而複方精油的功效更可以是單方的六倍，不妨參考香薰治療師的意見。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」再次展開，兒童體適能教練為大家準備了兩樽水，首先指導眾人接受需要負重的上肢肌力訓練。經過四個動作，主持姐姐已感到手臂酸軟。不過，當教練詢問可要加操時，前來參與的小朋友隨即點頭答應，展現滿滿鬥志。稍事休息後，教練接着帶淶下肢協調訓練，包括模仿企鵝般以腳跟走路、青蛙跳等動作，趣味十足。「動物好萌友」環節，則引領觀眾認識世界第二大企鵝品種— 國王企鵝。

programme.title: 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 大停電仍然持續，所有依靠電力的東西都無法使用。暖爐用煤油與車用汽油陷入短缺，連食物也成為搶奪對象。智悟發現沈武私下走入洞穴，追蹤下才發現沈武打算製作生物燃料，駕車前往風力發電站，嘗試恢復全鎮的電力。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子與姐姐參加社區舉辦的聖誕聯歡會，有機會與區內小孩聚首一堂，亦因此看到大人的種種窘態。小丸子在繪畫比賽獲獎，在全校集會上獲頒獎狀，卻在等候上台時人有三急，令她不知如何是好。

programme.title: 榮寶齋粵
programme.desc: 節目聚焦榮寶齋代代堅守、薪火相傳的百年歷程，透過榮寶齋這一中國文化與藝術發展的重要縮影，展現中國傳統文化的魅力與蓬勃的生命力。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
中國建築呈獻：2025國際大事回顧粵
programme.desc: 中美元首釜山會面，穩定全球最重要的雙邊關係。日本、南韓、泰國政壇相繼變天。其中日本選出的首位女首相高市早苗，發表涉台錯誤言論，令中日關係緊張。法國巴黎羅浮宮珠寶失竊案，震驚全球。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 東華三院善道同行粵
programme.desc: 眾藝員分兩隊參與競技賽，為踏入155周年、行善無界限的東華三院籌款。比拼後還合力疊高紙箱，務求籌得更多善款。陳庭欣、何泳芍、朱文慧出海滑水籌款，除了斟茶、寫字、轉呼拉圈，更出動教練滑住水跳繩，神乎奇技。大男孩蕭正楠、馬貫東則聯同「東華」小學生，透過射龍門籌款，幾難都要全中！此外，港姐冠軍陳詠詩擅長體操，要在移動中的車輛上完成動作，又會如何？還有袁偉豪駕駛越野電單車行平衡木、斜台飛車，既驚險又精彩！

programme.title: 使徒行者2諜影行動粵PG
programme.desc: 一份暗網的解鎖信息，令警界陷入前所未有的恐慌。為保護證據，警司程滔陷入危機，其師父葉志帆與兄弟井進賢亦因此交惡。警界內部敵友難分。隨著深入調查，一個多年來隱於幕後的恐怖組織漸漸浮出水面…

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 來自約旦的空手道世界冠軍艾查法利，早前來港出席交流會，向本港運動員與愛好者傳授經驗和技巧。摔跤新星宋樹仁為港爭光，勇奪日本青少年級別賽事冠軍。這位年僅十二歲的小將分享深刻點滴，並盼未來可更進一步。香港公開劍擊錦標賽召集本地好手同場比拼，張家朗、蔡俊彥等港將也有參與。網球冠軍盃邀請多地雙打精英，在室內賽場較技，戰況如何？

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 中國建築呈獻：2025財經大事回顧粵
programme.desc: 四月關稅戰開打衝擊全球貿易；出口疲弱、內需力度不足，加上地方債惡化，繼續困擾中國經濟；疫後本地經濟溫和復蘇、新股市場暢旺，但餐飲零售經營仍然充滿變數，2025財經大事回顧會和大家重溫過去一年，本港和環球財經市場的重要事件。

programme.title: 新鮮人#21粵
programme.desc: 家輝認為不能姑息韋權，遂與麗華報警。家謙欲向鋼琴大師于漸秀拜師，卻被琴行導師處處為難。阮盈從美國回來，更騙家謙已康復，但其實阮盈剛生了腫瘤。麗華不適，家輝細心照顧，麗華感動。家謙從錄影帶中苦練琴技，已能將艱深樂章背熟，家輝、麗華及家謙皆努力地朝自己目標前進。阮盈發覺家謙真正所愛的人其實是韋文，悄然返美。家輝參賽圖則被RAYMOND造手腳，不能入圍。家謙學琴的琴行被人踢館，要找出雙方學生進行比試。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 灣仔區經過多年發展，新舊文化共冶一爐，衛志豪、譚嘉儀、謝東閔一次過遊遍區內不同年代特色景點。於鬧市欣賞維港日落景緻，感覺浪漫寫意。三人走進香港故事館，從懷舊展品中尋找港人的拼搏痕跡。深入80年歷史露天市集，貼地感受灣仔街坊人情味。日式海鮮市場每日引進新鮮食材，刺身愛好者必然食指大動。經典大牌檔面臨絕跡，三人從香滑奶茶中細味過去60載輝煌點滴。嘉儀拿起結他在姻緣石前大唱情歌，莫非她在呼喚愛情來臨？

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 名人馬斯克除了是世界首富，還兼具多重身分。谷主們都對其人生故事充滿好奇，並設題討論。凱婷概述馬斯克的成長經歷與發跡過程，原來他曾被幼稚園校長認為智力發展遲緩！對於AI會否取代人類工作，凱文、泳嘉各有不同看法。馬斯克於推動AI發展影響深遠，但他曾在演講中直言AI是人類最大的生存威脅？三位谷主還會談論對馬斯克的深刻印象，泳嘉、凱文分別引述其金句，勉勵大家勇於面對挫折，凱婷則談到馬斯克的非一般營商理念。

programme.title: 全城一叮粵
programme.desc: 謝采芝藉一叮舞台追尋歌手夢，惟被指揀錯歌，她再唱一曲，為「復活」最後一拼！黃紫恩、劉展霆一拍即合，以性感火辣舞蹈引來陣陣尖叫，有人竟將焦點放在黑絲上……方紹聰、關嘉敏大膽挑戰棟篤笑，卻陷入被叮絕境，遂加碼展示Beatbox、Rap唱才藝，能否「重生」？在媽媽現場打氣下，陳懿德變身「女神」獻聲，自信心大增。入行逾廿載的劉家聰，戰勝重病歸來，冀以手影故事重獲觀眾掌聲；其女兒驚喜上台給予鼓勵，場面催淚！

programme.title: 你想減壓粵
programme.desc: 股評人胡孟青經常要不分晝夜地留意各地波動的股市，情緒亦易有起伏，隨時影響睡眠質素。青姐笑言豐滿身型源於喜歡吃喝，其減壓妙法是用餐或消閒時遠離「行家」，適當時機還要學懂放下！聆聽ASMR錄音、輕鬆音樂，均可幫助入睡，但原來經過慎選，「噪音」亦可助眠？註冊音樂治療師細說白噪音與粉紅噪音的分類。除聽覺外，透過嗅覺感受香薰的味道，也可舒緩緊張。而複方精油的功效更可以是單方的六倍，不妨參考香薰治療師的意見。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 粉紅之城齋浦爾以印度人最喜愛的藍色陶瓷聞名 獨一無二的手工藝品, 是送禮的上品 隨著平價的工廠製陶器引入而一度銷聲匿跡的藍陶, 全靠印度的代表藝術家克里帕爾令它復活, 這份珍貴的文化遺產材得以流傳至今

programme.title: 排檔尋情味粵英
programme.desc: 走進新加坡不同世代小販的生活，感受他們之間的關愛、爭吵以及他們對彼此堅定不移的支持。

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【王牌律師X怪物新人法律界最強拍檔真相一觸即發！】在韓國頂尖律師事務所KANG&HAM，崔江錫是無人能敵的王牌律師，精準果敢、戰無不勝。一次偶然，他遇見高延宇──沒有法學背景、未取得律師執照，卻擁有怪物般的驚人記憶力。慧眼識珠的江錫破格將他納入團隊，從此兩人成為法律界最強黃金拍檔。在法庭上縱橫捭闔、揭露真相與陰謀，他們並肩作戰，也建立深厚情誼，並在愛與抉擇間踏上命運的新篇章。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 逆轉女王
programme.desc: 【經典韓劇《賢內助女王》姊妹作】黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚。然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助。五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場。在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長。泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標。

programme.title: 最佳愛情
programme.desc: 【知名編劇「洪氏姊妹」執筆當紅VS過氣偶像間的戀愛羅曼史】正值演藝巔峰的獨孤振，不但是廣告界寵兒，更是國民好感度第一的男星！而具愛貞則是前當紅偶像團體「國寶少女」成員，因過氣只好跑跑通告維持生計。獨孤振在一次試鏡中，因英語程度不佳，丟失了出演機會，沒想到這丟人的祕密，居然被具愛貞給知道了！國民喜愛的男星碰上國民唾棄的女星，他們能克服眾人的偏見勇敢去愛嗎?一場荒謬又有趣的浪漫戀曲即將展開。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 【改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！】擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨。某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉和丈夫恩範已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因恩範外遇出軌導致離婚收場。荷拉時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 大學成人式-被不良少年迷住3-(完)
programme.desc: 【《魷魚遊戲》李廷晙、DAY6元弼、CIX炫晳、EPEX琴洞弦，眾多偶像齊聚一堂，共譜青春愛情劇！！】因一場誤會讓模範生妍鬥與校園惡霸賢浩有了連結，在結束了高中時期的紛擾，進入大學就讀的妍鬥與賢浩，以為平靜的日子將會是日常生活。隨著新認識的朋友，兩人想解決複雜的誤會和矛盾產生，看似複雜的愛情公式，誰才是妍鬥最終的選擇?

programme.title: 愛情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永攜手《社內相親》薛仁雅尋找幸福小確幸！！！】清雅是一名放棄戀愛和結婚，努力在生活中，連續八年準備警察公務員卻無法合格的社會小螺絲。俊輝則是一名對他人毫無興趣的不婚主義者，不管是愛情、友情還是親情都秉持N分之一的態度。認識了彼此開始尋找瑣碎但現實的小確幸，並開始認知愛情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung goes incognito to mix with his people and understand their needs. He encounters many strange things along the way, including being arrested and nearly beheaded. Who will save him?

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, it's cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat's knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit...

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrate's daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Shaolin Intruders
programme.desc: On a routine courier mission, the prestigious Chief was murdered by four mysterious monks. When all evidence pointed to Ching Hua, his friend Lei decides to clear his name by barging in the Shaolin Temple thrice. When Lei thought justice was served for the culprits, he soon realizes the table had turned and the monks stroke again. What follows is a series of intense pursuit for the ultimate villain!

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Chu Twin becomes crazy after his son's arms were chopped off. For no reason, he harms four people causing them various disabilities. The four disabled form a band to learn Kung Fu from a master, in order to take revenge on Chu Twin.

programme.title: The Empress Dowager
programme.desc: Award-winning drama featuring a passionate performance by Lisa Lu, enhanced by sumptuous costumes and sets, produces a powerful, fascinating story. In five thousand years of Chinese history, there was never a more fascinating woman than the dragon lady of the Ching Dynasty, also the Empress Dowager, who was the power behind the throne for the last half of the 19th century. The vast tapestry of palace intrigues is vividly brought to the screen.

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Long Chase
programme.desc: Governor Yan is killed and his guard Fan identifies Kou as the assassin by his signature weapon, a dart. Kou is listed as a wanted man when he enters the city, but managed to escape arrest with the help of the innkeeper's daughter. At the same time, Fan is attacked by a bandit who pretends to be Kou. What are the secret plots behind these attacks?

programme.title: Songfest
programme.desc: As its name implies, Songfest is an Eastmancolor-Shawscope costume musical, traditionally Chinese and timeless in content; yet revealing a spirited and modern technique. Shot on location at Taiwan's beautiful Sun-Moon Lake, it's a turbulent romance between a passionate tea picker Sung Yu Lan and a charming fisherman Li Chun Yang.

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: The Three Smiles
programme.desc: A talented scholar, Bo Hu, is attracted by the pretty maid, Qiu Xiang. In order to get close to her and win her love, he disguises as a servant to work in the same household. Qiu Xiang does not believe Bo Hu when he discloses his true identity to her, only falling in love with him when he reveals his talents and with his friends' help.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: The story is about the legendary Monkey King (Liu Chung-chun) teams up with Goddess of Mercy (Chao Li-chuan) and the Dragon Girl (Lung Nu) to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh (Ting Hua-chung),son of the Ox Demon (Hung Hai-erh) to rescue Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim (Teng Chio-jen).

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this "young" auntie, the nephew and his son. Kara Hui won Best Actress in the first Hong Kong Film Awards for her role as Dai Nan.

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Clan Feuds
programme.desc: Like legendary director Chu Yuan did so often and so successfully, Chang Peng Yi adapted this film from a story by Ku Lung. Following the footsteps of the equally legendary Chang Cheh, Chang also casted the majestic Ti Lung, along with "Venoms" Lo Meng and Sun Chien, for a spectacular showcase of mystical Martial Arts World's intrigue and consummate Kung Fu.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: Three Sinners
programme.desc: Based on the classic Ming Dynasty novel The Water Margin, Three Sinners is a Huangmei Opera about love, betrayal, murder, and redemption. Starring Hong Kong's premiere movie couple, it is one of the grandest Eastmancolor-Shawscope costume musicals in the Shaw Brothers library.

programme.title: Martial Arts of Shaolin
programme.desc: Zhi Ming, who trains at the Northern Shaolin Temple, teams up with Si Ma Yan, who trains at the Southern Shaolin Temple, to avenge both their fathers' death by assassinating a corrupt magistrate, leading to a series of fierce battles!

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Police has placed more than a thousand undercover officers in various triad groups to bring down the largest criminal organization in Hong Kong. Betrayal, deceit and murder bring this group of "brothers" into a collision with the law and with each other!

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation...

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 3
programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries his new partner Sophie, which shocked his only son, Ken. In the wake of Man's heart attack, Ken must battle Sophie - who has persuaded Man to transfer his grand master title to her in the event of his death - for the rightful claim to the family's gambling business in a riveting game of mahjong.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters' best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: A Chinese Tall Story
programme.desc: While finding ways to rescue his disciples, Monk Tripitaka meets the lizard imp Mei Yan, the ugliest woman alive. Despite the conflict between good and evil, he falls for Mei Yan who sacrifices herself to save him many times. The Monk breaks his "no killing" rule to save his disciples, and things get more complicated as Princess Galaxy appears...

programme.title: Long Arm of the Law Part 3
programme.desc: Chinese ex-soldier Li is wrongly accused and seeks refuge in Hong Kong to escape a death sentence. En route, he meets Sam and Moon. While Li has fallen in love with Moon, Hong Kong triad kidnaps Moon and coerces Li into aiding a robbery. Meanwhile, the mainland police officer tracks Li's path to Hong Kong, intensifying the chase.

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Eddie is hired by the Interpol to capture a human smuggling gang leader known as Snakehead. Eddie dies in an action to protect a sacred child from being kidnapped, but is brought back to life by the child's magical medallion, allowing him to finally kill Snakehead.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Ninth Happiness
programme.desc: A comedy starring many popular movie stars, this is a story about a magistrate and his brothers aiming to introduce sin and romance into the virtuous community of Rainbow Village. As they vie for the affections of a charming young village maiden, conflicts arise, adding a twist to their mischievous endeavours.

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Liu's investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Liu's investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy, a con artiste, when he is sent to prison for embezzlement, and Teddy teaches him all the gambling tricks. After their release, they team up with Teddy's lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, who framed Teddy for his sentence. Nick though is seduced by Lora and they end up in an affair. Will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Kill Time
programme.desc: Mak stumbles upon an obscure website "Witch's Zone" when looking for a copy of her dead father's favorite song. The mysterious website only allows one purchase but Mak cannot resist buying one more purple scarf. Not only does the scarf triggers her memories of her father and her first love, it may also be a vital clue in a mysterious murder.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Everlasting Regret
programme.desc: Adapted from an award-winning Chinese novel, the story follows the life of a legendary Shanghai beauty Wang Qi Yao from her glamorous to her simpler days. She stays true to her own way of life while surviving the constant betrayal of her men, and bears witness to the waves of change to her city from 1947 to 1981.

programme.title: To the Fore
programme.desc: The cycling team's top sprinter Zheng Zi Yuan teams up with two domestiques, Ming and Tian, who assist him to win the race. When Ming and Tian get tired of sacrificing their own chances to win, an accident causes the team to break up but the trio soon team up again for another race. Who will be the first to cross the line this time?

programme.title: Protege
programme.desc: Undercover Police Nick has spent 8 years working for the drug baron Quin, so as to collect evidence of his drug trafficking activities. After gaining Quin's trust, Nick becomes his protege and succeeds him as the drug baron when Quin retires. However, Nick has lost himself in his split life between trading drugs and searching for criminal evidence.

programme.title: Blueprint - Blueprint: Mongolia
programme.desc: Many people travel to Mongolia to disconnect, to escape into the vast wilderness and switch off. But for Mongolians, connectivity is everything. The country has 3.5 million people and 5 million active phone numbers. Everywhere you look in the capital city Ulaanbaatar, people are glued to their phones. A vibrant startup scene in the city is driving innovation and diversifying Mongolia's economy beyond its mining roots, fueled by a young, ambitious, and entrepreneurial population.

programme.title: Marketplace Europe - Europe's Unicorns at Web Summit Lisbon
programme.desc: Web Summit has become the must-attend conference in Europe for the tech world. For founders, investors, policymakers and startups, it provides a front-row seat for the tech debates that will shape our future. Europe continues to lag behind when it comes to unicorns - while the U.S. has around 800 startups valued at over $1billion, Europe has just over 200 - but that number has been growing with the AI boom, so we sat down with some of those leading lights in the continent's tech scene.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 - Arbor Day Disarray Ain't That the Tooth
programme.desc: Sandy gives her friends special saltwater trees, but they need more attention than she expected. SpongeBob and Patrick mistake a burglar for the tooth fairy.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S11 - Goons on the Moon
programme.desc: Sandy takes her "Science Scout" troop on a trip to the moon. In space, no one can hear you NYAH-NYAH-NYAH-NYAH!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S13 - The Flower Plot SpongeBob on Parade
programme.desc: The Chum Bucket is replaced by a flower shop with a charming new owner. The Krusty Krab enters a float in the annual Bikini Bottom Parade.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - Stuntin' Olly Olly Organ Free
programme.desc: Patrick gets a stunt double. Patrick's organs leave his body in protest.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S2 - Home Improvement Undivided Attention
programme.desc: Laird is nervous to host movie night at his house, so Ronnie Anne helps him pretend Arturo's pad is his own! Carlota can't seem to pay attention to anything but her phone, so Carlos sets her up - with a math tutor!

programme.title: The Casagrandes S2 - Karate Chops Taco The Town
programme.desc: Used to being top dog, Carl can't handle when Adelaide joins his karate class and becomes the star student. Hector starts selling Rosa's delicious tacos but gets overwhelmed when they're more popular than the mercado!

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - Skatey Cat Weather Beaten
programme.desc: Nervous to jump back on her board after a bad wipeout, will Ronnie Anne ever skate again? feat. Lincoln Loud. A powerful artifact is coming to the Great Lakes City museum and it brings along a storm for the Casagrandes!

programme.title: The Casagrandes S3 - Race Against the Machine My Fair Cat Lady
programme.desc: When Mr. Chang's job might go to a faster train conductor, he has to prove that he can be just as fast as a robot! Adelaide wants to help the city cats clean up their acts for adoption, but can she help these grumpy gatos?

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - Lost in Bikini Bottom Tutor Sauce
programme.desc: SpongeBob tries to take a shortcut to work, but becomes lost along the way. After failing his driver's test again, Mr. Krabs decides to teach SpongeBob how to drive himself.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - Squid Plus One The Executive Treatment

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - Company Picnic Pull Up a Barrel
programme.desc: Mr. Krabs throws a company picnic to boost morale, but Plankton is hosting his own on the same day! Mr. Krabs regales SpongeBob with tales from his old Navy days.

programme.title: Albert
programme.desc: Albert, a little Douglas fir tree who loves Christmas more than anyone, goes on a road trip from his little nursery to the big city to make his dreams come true.

programme.title: The Patrick Star Show S1 - Little Patscals The Pre-Historic Patrick Star Show
programme.desc: Patrick learns what GrandPat's childhood was like. Cave Pat hosts a show with his cave family.

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Mexican Makeover
programme.desc: Adelaide and Carl have an adventure on Mr. Chang's route, but can they work together to save the day?

programme.title: The Casagrandes S1 - Blunder Party

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP29
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: Madam Cutie On Duty - EP18
programme.desc: FA PING (Priscilla Wong), who was often made fun of by the others for being ugly during her childhood, underwent cosmetic surgery in the wake of an accident. Ever since then, she has been firmly convinced that an attractive appearance has a significant impact on one's life, and remains the same after joining the police.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP14
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: Battle Against Evil, The - EP15
programme.desc: General LI (TONG, MICHAEL) of the Chor Kingdom and wizard CHAI (CHAN HO, MOSES) were colleagues under the same mentor. LI killed CHAR when he found out that CHAR was having an affair with his wife SUKI (LEUNG TSAND, JADE). SUKI was ashamed of her affair, so she committed suicide. After she died, CHAI was furious and killed LI. He used bad magic to turn LI’s spirit into a cloud of hatred in order to prevent him from reincarnation.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP36
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.

programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: Madam Cutie On Duty - EP19
programme.desc: FA PING (Priscilla Wong), who was often made fun of by the others for being ugly during her childhood, underwent cosmetic surgery in the wake of an accident. Ever since then, she has been firmly convinced that an attractive appearance has a significant impact on one's life, and remains the same after joining the police.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP15
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: Battle Against Evil, The - EP16
programme.desc: General LI (TONG, MICHAEL) of the Chor Kingdom and wizard CHAI (CHAN HO, MOSES) were colleagues under the same mentor. LI killed CHAR when he found out that CHAR was having an affair with his wife SUKI (LEUNG TSAND, JADE). SUKI was ashamed of her affair, so she committed suicide. After she died, CHAI was furious and killed LI. He used bad magic to turn LI’s spirit into a cloud of hatred in order to prevent him from reincarnation.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP38
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.

programme.title: Bottled Passion - EP1
programme.desc: MRS. KO TUNG KWOK-HING (Chan Sau Chu) lies to her husband KO SHIU-TONG (Kwok Fung) that the orphan boy she brings home is his long lost illegal son, KO YEE-HO. TONG believes HO will make a better heir than his elder son, KO YEE-TAI (Chan Shan Chung), resulting in HING’s kicking HO out of the house in anger. HO has been living a vagabond life since. After having enough of the bitter taste of life, he is determined to let the KO family know how it feels to lose one’s family.
